scientific_limitations: Binary graph-incidence supports of all onto maps with n>q>=2 only; not a claim about online dimensions, general prescribed fiber sizes, or homological types. The bijective n=q boundary has known perfect-matching coverage and is not separately claimed as novel. Historical priority outside inspected sources is unresolved.
title: Shattering complexes of finite onto maps: a duplicate-color criterion and a matroid boundary
